summary: Bind Taiwan evaluation dataset materialization to the approved evaluation universe policy before immutable DatasetVersion creation, ensuring whole-market 1-bar extra quotes do not fail downstream evaluation minimum bar thresholds (>= 30 bars), while strictly maintaining fail-closed validation for missing/short policy instruments, checksums, and tenant boundaries.

diagnosis.actual_gha_observation: In qualification run 37702411985 at 54c6ebef90a8a7c779d19fee0fce0ae7a2184f81, 6326/6327 passed; after featureRefs boundary was restored, L4 persona_teaching preview evaluation failed at 23:37:36: 'RuntimeError: Teaching evaluation job failed: evaluation_admission_rejected: dataset instrument 00400A.TWSE has 1 bars; minimum is 30'.
diagnosis.root_cause: The TW official market connector generates daily snapshot quotes for the broader market (including symbols like 00400A.TWSE with 1 bar for the current date) alongside 30-day historical bars for tracked policy instruments (2330.TWSE, 2317.TWSE). Previously, materialize_source_dataset_version included all normalized records in the storage manifest without scoping to the approved evaluation policy universe before materializing the immutable DatasetVersion. When load_evaluation_authority evaluated the materialized DatasetVersion against threshold_policy.json (which requires min_bars_per_instrument=30 across all instruments in the dataset), it failed on the 1-bar whole-market instrument 00400A.TWSE.
diagnosis.producer_consumer_mismatch: The producer correctly produces full market quotes and historical series. Downstream evaluation policy (threshold_policy.json v3.0.0) governs the specific evaluation universe (required_instruments: 2317.TWSE, 2330.TWSE). The materializer previously lacked binding to this approved policy prior to immutable DatasetVersion construction, conflating the raw storage batch with the evaluation universe. Scoping records strictly to policy['required_instruments'] before materialization—while forbidding filtering by observed bar count or quality, and strictly failing closed if any required policy instrument is missing—aligns producer and consumer without weakening any validation or threshold.

fix.source_dataset_authority: materialize_source_dataset_version accepts policy_path or policy mapping, validates it against canonical evaluation policy authority schema and digest, scopes records strictly to policy['required_instruments'], enforces that all required instruments are present, stamps source_policy_selection and source_policy_selection_sha256 into DatasetVersion metadata, and includes expected_policy_selection_digest in cache key assertion to isolate cache keys.
fix.evaluation_authority: Retained unchanged; existing evaluation authority strictly verifies >= 30 bars on all instruments in the admitted DatasetVersion, perfectly matching the scoped dataset.
fix.main_service: In services/training-session/main.py, passed canonical TRAINING_SESSION_THRESHOLD_POLICY_PATH to materialize_source_dataset_version during snapshot loading.
fix.tests: Added 6 comprehensive unit and adversarial tests covering: whole-market 1-bar extras with policy selection, actual MarketDataStorageWriter output with multiple instruments and extras, adversarial fail-closed rejection on missing required symbol, adversarial rejection on short symbol (5 bars < 30) at evaluation, adversarial rejection on invalid policy status, and cache key isolation.
